identificationModule.briefTitle: ARX788 in HER2-positive Metastatic Breast Cancer Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ARX788 Given Every 6 Weeks in Patients with HER2-positive Advanced Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A phase 2 study of ARX788 given every 6 weeks in HER2-positive, metastatic breast cancer patients.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A single arm, phase 2 study of ARX788 in HER2-positive, metastatic breast cancer patients. The ARX788 will be administered every 6 weeks (Q6W) intravenous (IV) infusion.

interventions.name: ARX788
interventions.description: 2.2 mg/kg IV infusion on Day 1 of each 42-day treatment cycle.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of participants in the analysis population who have CR or PR per RECIST 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the percentage of participants in the analysis population who have CR or PR or SD per RECIST 1.1.
DOR is defined as the interval from response initiation (when either CR or PR is first determined) to progression or death, whichever occurs first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From response initiation (when either CR or PR is first determined) to progression or death, whichever occurs first, assessed up to 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS was defined as the time from first dose to first documented disease progression (PD) or death from any cause, whichever occurred first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From first dose to first documented disease progression (PD) or death from any cause, whichever occurred first, assessed up to 2 years.

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS was defined as the time from the first dose of study drug to any-cause death.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the date of first dose of study drug to any-cause death, assessed up to 5 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The number of subjects experiencing adverse event TEAEs
